verdict.rationale: Typesense's own docs list 'Faceting' and 'Filtering results' as sections of its search-application guide, and a community evaluator describes its faceted search running in-memory. So the engine ships faceting, but the evidence gives no detail on how deep it goes. missing for 10: documentation of live facet counts returned with results, range/numeric facets, multi-attribute facets in a single query, and hands-on corroboration of building faceted navigation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build faceted navigation — filters with live counts across categories, ranges, and attributes — from a single query

citations.quote: Searching for books ... Filtering results ... Faceting
